Observation and trigger: Detection in the specified view yields no valid target position; image and field-of-view provenance are retained.
Postcondition: A newly acquired image at the task-specified field of view contains the target.

Observation and trigger: The specimen side-view extent measured from a segmented image is below the prescribed threshold.
Postcondition: After additional milling, a new side-view image is acquired and segmented to remeasure the specimen; batch evaluation also checks the final simulator mesh independently.

Observation and trigger: The specimen does not move with the probe after retraction, contrary to the expected attachment state.
Postcondition: After reapproach, welding, and lifting, new images establish whether the specimen moves with the probe.
